thesis: The speakers argue that the investment conversation regarding return stacking has shifted from using alternatives to create all-weather portfolios to using them to generate excess returns on top of core equity positions like the S&P 500. They suggest that while large-cap U.S. equities are efficient, investors can unshackle their risk budget to stack assets they have higher confidence in, such as Bitcoin or specific stocks, rather than competing with other stock pickers.
